title: Block values used as randomness (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract hashes block values to derive a random result. Block producers and observers can predict or influence these values, so the outcome is not random. This lexical rule flags the derivation; the reviewer confirms the value is not used for chance.
remediation: Use a commit-reveal scheme or a verifiable randomness oracle for any outcome that needs unpredictability.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any hash over a block value matches, including non-random uses such as cache keys.
